parameters.query: SELECT id, type, statut, total, fait, parametres, cree_le, resultat FROM soins.taches WHERE ($1 <> '' AND id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid) OR ($1 = '' AND type = 'rapport_garde_etage' AND parametres->>'etage' = $2 AND cree_le > now() - interval '16 hours') ORDER BY cree_le DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT s.identifiant, g.nom, s.jeton_hash FROM soins.sessions s JOIN soins.soignants g ON g.identifiant = s.identifiant WHERE s.jeton_hash = $1 AND s.expire_le > now() AND g.actif
